name: American Pool 3D
releaseNotes: First managed-store release. Adds contact-aware cue/object-ball prediction guides and a pull-back POWER meter that controls shot speed.
description: American Pool 3D is an original landscape 8-ball pool game with touch cue control, realistic ball-contact previews, pull-back shot power, sampled pool effects, 8-ball rules, and a computer opponent.
